title: 36 Hours in Asheville, N.C.
abstract: Art lovers, hikers, connoisseurs of Southern cuisine and explorers of up-and-coming neighborhoods will find much to savor in this scenic city nestled in the Blue Ridge Mountains.

title: 36 Hours in Rotterdam, the Netherlands
abstract: With experimental restaurants and avant-garde architecture, the Netherlands’ second-biggest city embodies contemporary urban cool.

title: 36 Hours in Buenos Aires
abstract: Buenos Aires, Argentina’s capital, can feel overwhelming. But elegance can be found everywhere.

title: 36 Hours in Vancouver
abstract: The coastal British Columbian city is in transition, with the gravity of its cultural life shifting eastward.
